protocol.name: replication_stage_2
protocol.selection_policy: Descriptive sensitivity analysis of every declared setting. No parameter is selected using these labels for an independent validation claim. Resource measurements use the previously fixed ngram=3, top_k=10, indexing=right baseline.

resources.order: Each block shuffles dataset-stage jobs, executes them sequentially, and uses a fresh process per job.
resources.memory: Peak process RSS from resource.getrusage, including interpreter, imports and input loading. Scheduling workers load a common candidate snapshot; candidate workers load source CSVs. No claim of incremental algorithm-only memory.

metadata.measurement_notes: Single run. Python memory tracing is optional; when enabled, peak includes inputs, evaluation and all output rows; not per-strategy RSS. Scheduling measured once at maximum budget. Verification time excluded. Synthetic fixtures are pipeline checks only.
metadata.progressive_recall_definition: sum(recall(b) for b=1..B)/B; constant tail after exhaustion
metadata.pyjedai_auc_definition: sum(recall(b) for b=1..L)/(L+1), L=min(B,number of candidates); no tail
